Limitations of US FDA recall data for Kenyan procurement: covers products sold in the US market only; a firm may supply Kenya from a different site or with different products; no FDA recall does not prove good quality; the recalling firm is often a repackager, distributor or compounding pharmacy rather than the manufacturer; FDA publishes recalls about 7 weeks after they start; Kenyan PPB data, WHO prequalification and GMP inspection reports must be checked separately.

Checks before awarding a pharmaceutical supply contract (decision support, not a decision): confirm the actual manufacturing site; verify PPB registration of product and site; obtain the current GMP certificate or inspection outcome; request certificates of analysis; for nitrosamine-prone products request a nitrosamine risk assessment; for sterile products request sterility assurance evidence; request stability data for Zone IVb; consider independent testing at the national quality control laboratory.

Methods: recall reasons classified by TF-IDF + logistic regression into 10 categories; monthly recall events by FDA publication month; alerts from rolling z-score, IQR and walk-forward Isolation Forest using only the previous 12 months; consensus = 2 or more methods.
